title: "Q1"
output: html_document

```{r load-data-Q1, echo = TRUE}
# Load readr using pacman
pacman::p_load(readr)

# Load the data
Benchmark <- read_rds("data/Capped_SWIX.rds")
Active_Managers <- read_rds("data/Active_Managers.rds")
ABC_Fund <- read_rds("data/ABC_Fund.rds")

```


```{r}
## Load packages
pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,
  lubridate,
  PerformanceAnalytics
)

## 2. Build a matched ABC_Fund + Benchmark panel --------------------------

# Keep a single benchmark series and line it up with ABC_Fund dates
df_q1 <- 
  ABC_Fund %>% 
  arrange(date) %>% 
  left_join(
    Benchmark %>% 
      select(date, BM_Returns = Returns),  # benchmark returns
    by = "date"
  )

head(df_q1)
# A tibble: date, Returns (ABC_Fund), BM_Returns (benchmark)

## 3. Convert to xts objects for PerformanceAnalytics ---------------------

# ABC_Fund excess returns series
Ra <- xts::xts(df_q1$Returns, order.by = df_q1$date)
colnames(Ra) <- "ABC_Fund"

# Benchmark series
Rb <- xts::xts(df_q1$BM_Returns, order.by = df_q1$date)
colnames(Rb) <- "Capped_SWIX"

# (If you do not have a risk free series in this question, set Rf = 0)
Rf <- 0
```

```{r}
## 4. CAPM beta and alpha for ABC_Fund vs benchmark -----------------------

# CAPM Beta (monthly data)
CAPM.beta(Ra = Ra, Rb = Rb, Rf = Rf)

# Monthly alpha, annualised the same way as in the example:
(1 + CAPM.alpha(Ra = Ra, Rb = Rb, Rf = Rf))^12 - 1


```


```{r}
## 5. Rolling 3-year (36-month) beta --------------------------------------

chart.RollingRegression(
  Ra        = Ra,
  Rb        = Rb,
  width     = 36,          # 3 years of monthly data
  attribute = c("Beta"),
  main      = "Rolling 36-month CAPM Beta: ABC Fund vs Capped SWIX"
)

```

```{r}
## 6. Summary single-factor model table -----------------------------------

table.SFM(Ra = Ra, Rb = Rb)

```
